rules.statement: A gift made many years after a marriage does not fall under the proviso to section 6(d) of the Estate Duty Ordinance if it was not made on the occasion of the marriage, contingent on the marriage taking place, or for the purpose of encouraging or facilitating the marriage.
rules.supporting_quote: "In the first place it was not made on the occasion of the marriage since the marriage took place seven years earlier. Secondly, it was not conditioned only to take effect on marriage because, as stated earlier, the evidence disclosed that it was a love match and this property was not given as a condition for the marriage to take place. Thirdly, the evidence shows that it was not made for the purpose of or with a view to encouraging or facilitating the marriage."
